scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten.
Cb: A dedicated indoor section adequate for a small bridge cohort of children aged 24 to 36 months, without exact gross area metrics ready.
I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
Ce: A healthy indoor thermal environment that avoids drafts and high heating costs, without a predetermined certification grade.
I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I have no requirement on proximity to public transport.

The supplied regional standard specifies 6 sqm of net usable area per child across designated activity, rest, and toilet spaces, with a verified capacity range of 6–20 children; this is not a gross-area threshold, so the property's reported surface alone cannot establish capacity. Integration with a qualifying host facility is required. Planning compatibility, building and use-change permissions, health and hygiene standards, accessibility, fire and structural safety where applicable, and sector authorization all need verification. The applicable regulatory regime may also depend on the transition described for D.G.R. 3-1937/2025.
pros: Existing school and educational use provides a relevant starting point for integration with a kindergarten, subject to confirming host-facility requirements and authorization.

cons: The 535.56 sqm property area is a gross dataset measure and does not establish the required net usable area, room layout, or capacity for 6–20 children.
Turin PRG compatibility, any required building title or change of use, hygiene, accessibility, structural and fire requirements, and sector authorization remain to be checked.
